description:
App Store & Google Play Reviews API

iOS App Store and Google Play reviews as one JSON stream: rating, title, text, app version, date, helpful votes, developer replies, country and language. Both stores in one actor, from $0.09 per 1,000 reviews.

Pricing (pay per event, billed to your Apify account): Review: $0.00009.

Runs on Apify as subimpact/app-reviews-api.

_maxChargeUsd.description: Per-run spending cap in USD (default 0.5). Passed to Apify as the run option maxTotalChargeUsd, so the run stops when it reaches this charge.
_maxChargeUsd.title: Max charge (USD)

_maxItems.description: How many dataset items to return to the model (1-1000, default 50). Truncates the response only; it does not change what the Actor collects or charges for.
_maxItems.title: Max items returned

apps.description: Apps to pull reviews for. Paste anything that identifies an app and the store is detected automatically: App Store URLs (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/instagram/id389801252), bare Apple ids (id389801252 or 389801252), Google Play URLs (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.instagram.android) or bare package names (com.instagram.android). Mix both stores in one run.
apps.title: Apps

country.description: Two-letter store country: us, gb, de, my, sg, in, jp, br… The store's country decides which reviews exist (App Store storefront, Google Play country) and both stores return reviews written in every language for that country.
country.title: Country

language.description: Language code used for the store pages and for the App Store's amp-api interface language, e.g. en, de, fr, pt-BR, zh-Hans. Review text is always returned as the reviewer wrote it.
language.title: Language

maxRating.description: Skip reviews with more stars than this (1-5). Leave empty for no upper bound.
maxRating.title: Max rating

maxReviewsPerApp.description: Cap on delivered reviews for each app (1-50000). The default of 200 reviews per app keeps a two-app default run at about four cents. Apple: up to 500 reviews per app come from Apple's public review feed (sorted, with app version); above 500 the actor switches to Apple's deeper web endpoint, which pages past 500 but does not expose the app version.
maxReviewsPerApp.title: Max reviews per app

minRating.description: Skip reviews with fewer stars than this (1-5). Leave empty for no lower bound.
minRating.title: Min rating

sinceDate.description: Only deliver reviews published on or after this date. ISO format, e.g. 2026-01-01 or 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z. With sort=newest the actor stops paging once it reaches older reviews, so it does not crawl history it will not deliver.
sinceDate.title: Since date

sort.description: newest = newest reviews first (recommended with sinceDate, the run stops paging as soon as it reaches older reviews). mostRelevant = the store's own relevance / most-helpful ordering, which is not chronological.
sort.title: Sort order

name: app_reviews
